purpose: Blind coverage and clock audit, no event observation values; frozen before any event forecasts were queried.
cohort_rule: Three physically and date-separated NWS-documented episodes in the pre-2025 eastern river forecast domain, paired to one designated official gauge per distinct episode. This is a purposive feasibility sample, not representatively random. No substitution within version 1.
clock: later of archived WMO dissemination minute and SHEF explicitly UTC DC minute; require uncorrected UTC SHEF and public WMO record; forecast issue strictly before valid time
product: NWS-authored RVF public SHEF in Iowa Environmental Mesonet historical archive; early screen preserves only HGIFE surface-stage forecasts, no observed HGIx event values or discharge conversion
tie_break: select most recent eligible issue per episode and target only if no unresolved disagreement at that timestamp; exact duplicate copies de-duplicated
later_observation_join: USGS continuous exact valid UTC timestamp only; pinned matching site & one 00065/00011 approved series in ft; no interpolation, value-based matching, unverified datum conversion, or observed peaks for target selection; measurement/approval and public issue clocks are distinct.
minimum_to_proceed: At least two independently selected event groups should have forecast/identifier eligibility; no accuracy claim in phase 1 even if all are eligible.
